alerts.description: Minor flooding possible in low-lying areas near the Sacramento River due to sustained rainfall. Urban drainage may be overwhelmed in some areas.
Conditions are favorable for severe thunderstorms Saturday. Damaging winds, heavy rain, and small hail possible. Wine country vineyards may see localized flooding.
Northwest winds of 20-30 mph with gusts to 45 mph expected along the Front Range. Secure outdoor objects and use caution while driving.
